Hi team,

Following the two calls this week — quick debrief and flagged follow-ups. I’m attaching a short note file with bullet takeaways.

Thomas Lee (Globex) — 22 Jun, 9:05–9:22 PT
- Context: Thomas was Vivienne’s manager on a 9-person payments modernization squad. He described Vivienne as reliable, clear on tradeoffs, and someone who "made teams calm during high-pressure pushes."
- Strengths: diagnosis under ambiguity, stakeholder synthesis, on-time delivery.
- Clarifying question: Thomas mentioned Vivienne led a cross-team retrofit; he can share a 1-page artifact if we want concrete examples.

Rachel O'Connor (Finco) — 23 Jun, 13:02–13:20 PT
- Context: Peer contributor on data pipeline migration. Rachel noted Vivienne's attention to test quality and mentoring newer engineers.
- Strengths: code ownership, peer mentorship, pragmatic tradeoffs.
- Concern: Rachel said Vivienne can be cautious when scope is ill-defined; suggested she thrives with clearer milestones.

Action items:
- Jonas: follow up with Thomas for the 1-page artifact (if we want more detail).
- Mina: fold these bullets into the hiring packet and the debrief doc.
